headline: Blue Jackets’ Conor Garland out indefinitely with upper-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Blue Jackets forward Conor Garland is out indefinitely with an upper-body injury, with head coach Rick Bowness saying he won't play Tuesday night. It's more bad news for a CBJ team sitting at 7-8-0.

Garland hasn't produced so far this season: no goals and one assist in 15 games. But the chances he's generated point to some bad luck. His expected goals (the quality of his shots, added up) total 1.56, so he's about a goal and a half short of what those looks should have yielded. Still, CBJ controls just 43% of the 5-on-5 expected goals with him on the ice, about six points worse than when he sits, so his results weren't the only issue. Columbus overall sits at 46% of expected goals, and goalie play (+4.4 goals saved above expected) is carrying them. Going by how Bowness has used his players, Steven Lorentz (8:45 a night) is next in line for Garland's 14:09 and second power-play unit time, though that is a projection, not something we've seen yet.
